source_row.stem: A nurse experiencing back strain undergoes a workplace ergonomic assessment. This assessment is intended to:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Identify specific workplace factors contributing to physical strain and recommend modifications to reduce injury risk","B":"Considered to offer little practical benefit toward identifying or reducing a nurse's physical strain at work","C":"Intended for use only with office-based workers, rather than staff performing direct client care duties","D":"Intended to fully replace the need for any safe patient handling equipment already available on the unit"}}
source_row.rationale: Workplace ergonomic assessments identify specific factors contributing to physical strain and recommend modifications (equipment, technique, workflow) to reduce injury risk, applicable across healthcare roles including direct patient care.
